title: Priyanka Gandhi Recounts Childhood After Indira Gandhi's Assassination
summary: Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra stated on Thursday that after her grandmother, former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, was assassinated, she, along with her brother Rahul Gandhi, studied at home from the age of 12. She described this period as being like confinement, where they could not go out. Gandhi shared this anecdote while speaking at a location in Sultanpur Lodhi.
